title: Moya-xiviri Lowu Rindzaka eRibuweni ra Nambu
intro: Moya-xiviri lowuntshwa a wu nyikiwe vurhumiwa bya le xihundleni, leswaku wu languta wu ri ekule lowu hlayisekeke loko vumundzuku byi ri karhi byi humelela ematini. Leswi a swi nga voniwi naswona a swi nga ehleketiwi, nhlayo leyi a yi ta hoxa xandla swinene eku cinceni ka ndlela leyi matimu ya tiko ri fambaka ha yona.
clues: Ndzi nyikiwe ntirho hi manana, lowu a wu lava ku tumbela ni ku xalamuka.
Mahlo ya mina a ma landzela xibedlhele lexitsongo lexi a xi ri karhi xi khuluka hi mati, mbilu ya mina yi tika hi ku vilela.
Loko yi kumiwa hi ntlawa lowu a ndzi nga wu langutelanga, ndzi tshinele, ndzi tele hi ku chava.
Ndzi vone ku heleriwa hi ntshembo ka vona eka muhlayisi kutani ndzi nyikela ntlhantlho handle ko paluxa ntiyiso.
Ku nghenelela ka mina hi nkarhi ku vuyisele moya-xiviri lowu an’wisaka eka loyi a wu lava ngopfu.
Etihubyeni ta vanhu lava nga ni matimba, ndzi vulavule ndzi ku: ‘Xana ndzi ta ku kongomisa endyangwini lowu nga ta n’wi wundla ni ku n’wi khathalela hi vukheta?’

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: U tlhele a hlanganisa n’wana loyi ni mana wakwe
U tiponise eka masocha ya Faro
outcome.answer: U tlhele a hlanganisa n’wana loyi ni mana wakwe

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
